name: estate-planning-document-assembler
display_name: Estate Planning Document Assembly Skill for Law Firms
description: One skill: /estate-documents. Attach your intake answers and, optionally, your firm's own state-specific templates; the skill populates a basic will, healthcare POA, financial POA, and HIPAA authorization from one intake pass, flagging missing required fields per document type. Attorney verifies state execution formalities and finalizes before the client signs. Assisted draft, always reviewed — never determines execution requirements or submits anything automatically.
